tasks.prompt:
FIRST: check whether anything substantive has changed since the last vault summary. Run `git log --since="40 minutes ago" --oneline` and `git status --short`. If there are no new commits, no changed files in the working tree, and no PR state changes since the last drop, **skip this fire entirely — do not drop a note**. Output a single line saying "no-op, nothing to summarise" and stop.

Otherwise, drop a concise vault summary using mcp__second-brain__drop_note (area=personal, project=NeuralKeys, source=claude-code-typing-trainer, type=summary). Cover only what changed since the last summary: new commits (with hashes), PRs opened/merged/closed, files modified, decisions made, anything surprising. Bullet points. file:line citations where relevant. Tight.
